parsed.public_message: Blue confirms neutral to all under the t=300 compact, with one full turn of public notice before any change. All forces remain stationary on West Plateau with no scouts deployed.

private_messages.Claude: Thanks for the intel on Green at (~740,610) by the western side of the ford. We are holding West Plateau with no scout out, so we have no direct sight of White yet, though Green reported nothing visible from (822,755) either—confirming White is staying up on Central Heights. Let me know if your scout spots Green's or White's unit composition.
private_messages.GPT: Thanks for the coordinates. We are holding stationary on West Plateau with no scouts out and have seen no White or Orange units from our ridge. Keep me posted if your scout spots any unit compositions or movement from White or Orange.
private_messages.Grok: Neutral holds and we remain stationary on West Plateau with no scouts out. From shared reports, Orange's lone scout is in the centre lowlands (~666,589) and Green's main force is near the ford (~740,610) with a scout east at (~822,755), both staying clear of our ridges.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 3 (t=50s): All 4 players are neutral. All our squads are safely on West Plateau high ground at 360-393m from center (inside the t=300 ring of 420m) and completely unseen in fog of war. Nudging hero from (285,700) to (265,712) to sit directly beside elephants (261,717). Intel from Claude & GPT: GPT main army is at (~740,610) near the river ford with a scout at (822,755); Claude main army is on Little Hill with a cavalry scout at (666,589) staying east of x=480; Grok is holding Central Heights with no scout out.
parsed.explanation: With the four-way neutrality pact holding and our entire army hidden on West Plateau inside the t=300 ring radius, we nudge Seleucus I into the center of our elephant formation and hold position. Meanwhile, we cross-reference scout reports from Claude and GPT to track enemy positions around the central lowlands and river ford without exposing our own composition.
